verification.notes: A current transcript of the cited episode reproduces Blake Neff's statement that Charlie Kirk remained an evangelical Christian and practiced Sabbath observance throughout the relevant period. Independent reporting also describes Kirk as evangelical and says he began keeping the Sabbath in 2021; this verifies the attribution and broad background.
